title: phlegmariurus mesoamericanus
intro: Phlegmariurus mesoamericanus, commonly known as Mesoamerican horsetail, is a type of plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus mesoamericanus include acting as an expectorant to relieve respiratory congestion and as an anti-inflammatory to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
